maddeler.e:
اكتحلت (form VIII)
# اِكْتَحَلْتُ (iktaḥaltu) /ik.ta.ħal.tu/: first-person singular past active of اِكْتَحَلَ (iktaḥala)
# اِكْتَحَلْتَ (iktaḥalta) /ik.ta.ħal.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of اِكْتَحَلَ (iktaḥala)
# اِكْتَحَلْتِ (iktaḥalti) /ik.ta.ħal.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِكْتَحَلَ (iktaḥala)
# اِكْتَحَلَتْ (iktaḥalat) /ik.ta.ħa.lat/: third-perso
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
